_comment: Configuration variables of the modules (section 4 of each spec) for this installation. Set as defaults at start-up; the process environment wins. CSP addresses and keys come from demo.py. Empty CSP_ISSUER_URL = route STUB of C4-M1 (hackathon, OP-53); `demo.py --csp-issuer` points it to the issuer API of the CSP stand-in.
